_comment: Session 9: the full-screen map (tap the minimap or press M). zoom = screen pixels per metre (start, min, max). labelZoom = names of shops are written from this zoom up (big places always). colors for the route line and the police dots. policeEvery = seconds between police position updates on the maps. routeArriveMetres = the route is cleared this close to the target. legend = which groups are listed (ids: school, shops by kind, health, healthpack, police).
